Container.Name: zettnas-toolkit
Container.Overview: ZettNAS Toolkit: a web desktop for your NAS. Files and shares, Docker apps from a catalog, virtual machines, scheduled backups, private AI search and chat over your own files, disk health and a ransomware guard. On ZettLab and Aoostar hardware it also drives the front LCD, the fan curves and the lightbar.

Config.Name: Persistent State & Data
Config.Description: Persistent state, sqlite database, configurations, and wallpapers

Config.Name: Storage Pool
Config.Description: Target user array pool for disk usage calculation and file ingest

Config.Name: Unraid emhttp Telemetry
Config.Description: Unraid real-time array, parity check and mover state

Config.Name: Host Timezone
Config.Description: Host local time for synchronous clock and LCD display

Config.Name: Unraid Network Config
Config.Description: Unraid network configuration for interface and gateway resolution

Config.Name: Docker Socket
Config.Description: Host Docker socket for container telemetry and management

Config.Name: WebUI Password
Config.Description: Optional first-time admin password. Leave empty and one is generated: it is shown in the container log and saved as initial-admin-password in the app data folder. You choose your own at first sign-in.

Config.Name: AI Data Encryption Key
Config.Description: Optional. Encrypts the AI search index and chat history at rest (16+ characters, e.g. openssl rand -base64 32). Keep a copy in your password manager: without it the chat history cannot be read. Kept here, outside the appdata folder, so copies of appdata stay unreadable.
